offering_description.value: Grindr operates a social networking app for gay, bi, trans, and queer adults. Users can connect and chat with people nearby and discover curated products, services, and information through the platform.

quotes.quote: Grindr has grown into the world’s largest network for gay, bi, trans, and queer adults. Each day, millions of people in nearly every country open the app to connect, chat, and build community.

Today that foundational utility is evolving into the Global Gayborhood—an AI-powered platform where proximity unlocks instant access not only to one another but also to curated products, services, and trustworthy information, all in one place. By stitching these essentials into a single, fluid experience, Grindr now serves as the growth engine of gay life worldwide.
Grindr is the world’s largest social networking app for gay, bi, trans, and queer people. Download Grindr today to discover, connect to, and explore the queer world around you.
